q: How do I generate an image?
a: Navigate to the main workspace, choose Image as your creative type, enter your prompt, pick an aspect ratio, and click Generate. Required credits are reserved upfront.

q: Why was my generation charged even though it failed?
a: Check the exact job and its wallet entries. A reservation is not a final charge. Delayed or MANUAL_REVIEW jobs can retain reservations until the outcome is known; do not resubmit an ambiguous request.

q: Can I download my generated assets?
a: Yes! Open any asset from the Asset Library (/assets) and click Download. Bounded derivatives are served in the UI, but original media is exported intact.

q: How do I top up my credits?
a: Contact your workspace owner or finance team to arrange a credit top-up. Pixel cannot grant credits.
